newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda's Demio minivan production totals 100,000.
newsitem.headline: Mazda's Demio minivan production totals 100,000.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Thursday that total output of its minivan Demio reached 100,000 vehicles as of June 30.
The company began producing the model in July 1996 and launched the minivan in the domestic market in August.
The minivan has been also sold in overseas markets. It was introduced in Hong Kong and Macau last October and Australia and New Zealand in November.
Mazda said earlier this week that it would boost output at one of its two domestic car plants to meet increasing demand from Europe.

The company plans to raise the operation rate at its Hofu plant in western Japan to an average of 50 percent of capacity in the period to September 30, 1997 and to an average of 60 percent during the six months to March 31, 1998.
